messages:
nina (sec): Heads-up - after the RBAC policy roll at 03:40 UTC I'm seeing KMS decrypt denies in us-east-1 and eu-west-1 correlated with a small uptick in mTLS handshake failures from sidecar proxies. Example logs: `2026-03-22T03:42:11Z principal=svc-cert@us-east-1 action=Decrypt error=AccessDenied` and `sidecar: TLS handshake failed: missing cert`.

kevin (infra): looking now. The policy change tightened keystore roles and removed a wildcard principal used by older rotator instances. Could be a staging->prod selector mismatch.

certrotator-bot: rotator alert: region=us-east-1 service=cert-rotator status=DECRYPT_FAIL count=7 last_error=AccessDenied. Backoff scheduled.

ash (platform): quick question - are active sessions dropping or only new handshakes?

nina (sec): mostly new handshakes during rotation windows. Clients with cached sessions keep working, but new connects for pods that restarted hit the problem.

kevin (infra): mitigation options: (A) add temporary allow for `kms:Decrypt` scoped to `arn:aws:iam::222:role/old-rotator` in the affected regions, (B) revert the PR that removed the wildcard principal, (C) enable a local PEM cache fallback on proxies so they can serve the last-known key until rotator fixed. My preference is A + C: quick short allow and enable fallback to reduce customer impact.

ash (platform): I can flip the PEM cache flag in the proxy config. Command: `kubectl -n infra patch configmap/proxy-config -p '{"data":{"enable_peM_cache":"true"}}'` (will push a rolling restart). That buys time.

kevin (infra): I'll prepare the IAM patch for a targeted allow. Patch snippet: ```- Effect: Allow  Action: kms:Decrypt  Resource: arn:aws:kms:*:222:key/*  Principal: arn:aws:iam::222:role/old-rotator  Condition: StringEquals: aws:RequestedRegion: ["us-east-1","eu-west-1"]``` Will deploy as temporary controlled change with 1-hour auto-revoke.

nina (sec): add audit rule to detect the temporary allow usage: query `source=\"aws.cloudtrail\" eventName=Decrypt errorCode!=null` and alert if it spikes after policy flip. Also create a runbook step that documents the rollback path.

certrotator-bot: action: PEM cache enabled in us-east-1 clusters. Rotator instances still reporting decrypt fails - pending IAM patch.

kevin (infra): IAM patch deployed to us-east-1 and eu-west-1 with expiry tag `exp:2026-03-22T05:00:00Z`. Monitoring for decrypt successes...

nina (sec): logs show rotator decrypt success events post-patch. Handshake failures dropping. Scoreboard: rotator decrypt failures -> 7/min -> 0-1/min. Sidecar handshake errors -> reduced by 90% in 10m.

ash (platform): rolling restart finished, proxies serving cached PEM while rotator recovers. No customer-facing errors seen in last 8 minutes.

kevin (infra): root cause summary: policy-generator unintentionally excluded `old-rotator` due to a name-normalization bug when converting service tags. The generator treated `old-rotator` as ephemeral and removed it from principal lists. We'll patch generator to preserve explicit exceptions and test against a canonical role list.

nina (sec): long-term items: 1) CI smoke: run an actual KMS decrypt using the IAM role before policy promotion, 2) add an integration test that simulates rotation and validates proxies can fall back to cached keys, 3) require region-scoped tests when changing keystore policies.

kevin (infra): PR opened: https://git.internal/r/policy-gen/pulls/58 - adds name-normalization fix and a CI KMS-decrypt step. Requesting reviewers.

nina (sec): plan for cleanup: remove temporary IAM allow after 1h unless we need more time. Also audit the last 24h of `Decrypt` denies to ensure no other services impacted.

certrotator-bot: temp-allow tag present. Reminder set to auto-revoke at 2026-03-22T05:00:00Z.

ash (platform): I'll create a customer-facing blurb for affected orgs with what happened and mitigations taken.

kevin (infra): scheduling: will merge fix after 2 approvals and run CI smoke in canary region before global rollout. Also adding a checklist item to policy-generator PR template: `kms-decrypt-smoke: done`.

nina (sec): thanks all. Postmortem owners: kevin (fix) and ash (platform mitigations). Assigning sev-3. We'll follow up with postmortem doc in ~48h. :lock:
